skills.name: Memory environment diagnostics
skills.description: Verify the toolchain is ready before memory work.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.env.diagnose to check su, busybox and tool availability.
2. root.info to confirm root access.
3. If any component fails, report exactly which and stop.
4. Only proceed when the environment is green.

skills.name: Target process discovery
skills.description: Find the right process before touching memory.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.process.list to enumerate processes.
2. Match by package name; note pid and user.
3. Verify with a second listing that the pid is stable.
4. Record the pid for all subsequent mem.* calls.

skills.name: Memory region mapping
skills.description: Understand the target address space first.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.regions for the target pid.
2. Classify regions: heap, stack, anonymous RW, file-backed.
3. Note permissions per region; never write to r-x or r-- regions.
4. Record candidate scan regions for the value hunt.

skills.name: Unknown-value scan flow
skills.description: Find a value when you do not know its type.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.scan first-scan on candidate regions.
2. Change the value in-game; mem.scan refine with the new value.
3. Narrow to a handful of addresses.
4. Confirm with mem.read before any mem.write.

skills.name: Known-value scan flow
skills.description: Find a value whose exact number you can observe.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.scan exact value on RW regions.
2. Change the value once; rescan with the new number.
3. Repeat until candidates converge.
4. Verify with mem.read; document the address.

skills.name: Controlled memory writes
skills.description: Write to verified addresses with backups.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.read the original bytes at the target.
2. mem.write the new value; small, aligned writes only.
3. mem.read to verify; observe in-game effect.
4. Keep a record for rollback via mem.write of originals.

skills.name: Data type discipline
skills.description: Match scan type to the real storage type.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Suspect float for health/speed/coordinates; int for counts/currency.
2. Try dword first; switch to float when dword refines fail.
3. Beware doubled values (display*2) common in games.
4. Let refinement results guide the type; never force it.

skills.name: Pointer chain chasing
skills.description: Find stable bases through pointer chains.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find the dynamic address via scans.
2. mem.read pointer-sized values at candidate offsets to walk the chain.
3. Validate the chain survives a game restart.
4. Document the final chain as base+off1+off2.

skills.name: Float value tuning
skills.description: Tune float values precisely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate the float address (mem.scan).
2. mem.write a slightly larger value; observe direction of effect.
3. Binary-search the sweet spot in small steps.
4. Verify persistence after scene changes.

skills.name: Library injection with verification
skills.description: Inject a library and prove it landed.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.env.diagnose to confirm injector prerequisites.
2. mem.inject with the library path.
3. mem.inject.verify to confirm mapping.
4. If anti-tamper kills it, try mem.zygisk spawn-time injection.

skills.name: Zygisk spawn-time injection
skills.description: Bypass startup anti-tamper via spawn injection.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm Zygisk environment with mem.env.diagnose.
2. mem.zygisk with the target package and library.
3. Launch the game; mem.inject.verify mapping.
4. Check logcat for injection errors.

skills.name: Stealth memory operations
skills.description: Operate without tripping integrity checks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.stealth to enable stealth mode before writes.
2. Perform the modification.
3. mem.stealth.verify to confirm masking.
4. Keep sessions short; re-verify after game updates.

skills.name: Anti-detection hardening
skills.description: Reduce modification footprints.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.antidetect before gameplay modifications.
2. Re-apply after game restarts (protections re-init).
3. Watch for crash-on-detect patterns in logcat.
4. Combine with mem.stealth for layered cover.

skills.name: Visual value adjustment
skills.description: Modify values with on-screen verification.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the on-screen value source (health bar, score).
2. mem.scan and narrow to the backing address.
3. mem.visual.adjust with the target change.
4. mem.visual.verify to confirm the screen reflects it.

skills.name: Visual auto-play agent
skills.description: Run the see-think-act game loop.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Launch the game (androidopenapp).
2. mem.visual.autoplay to start the perception loop.
3. Monitor its actions; intervene when it gets stuck.
4. Stop and summarize learned patterns for the session.

skills.name: Static-to-runtime correlation
skills.description: Bridge static analysis and live memory.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Get the static address via re.il2cpp.resolve or re.ghidra.analyze.
2. Find the module base with mem.regions.
3. re.mem.ida_correlate to compute the runtime address.
4. Verify with mem.read of expected content.

skills.name: Health value management
skills.description: Locate and manage health-like values.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. First scan current health; take damage; refine scan.
2. Repeat until few candidates remain.
3. mem.read to confirm; mem.write or freeze via repeated writes.
4. Observe two rounds of damage before claiming success.

skills.name: Currency and resource edits
skills.description: Modify counted resources safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Spend or gain currency once to enable refinement.
2. mem.scan refine to the exact integer.
3. Confirm with mem.read; check for mirrored/derived values.
4. Write a conservative value; observe sync behavior with servers.

skills.name: Game speed adjustment
skills.description: Locate speed multipliers.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.scan float candidates around typical speed values.
2. Change in-game speed context if possible; refine.
3. mem.write modest changes; extreme values break physics.
4. Verify stability for a full minute of play.

skills.name: Position data reading
skills.description: Read player coordinates from memory.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.scan float triples near movement changes.
2. Walk in one axis; refine by delta direction.
3. Confirm the triple with mem.read during movement.
4. Document the layout; useful for automation.

skills.name: Render data discovery
skills.description: Find values used by the renderer.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Suspect matrices near known coordinate values.
2. mem.scan around the position triple for adjacent structures.
3. Validate changes visually via mem.visual.verify.
4. Document offsets for repeat sessions.

skills.name: Post-crash memory recovery
skills.description: Recover gracefully when the target dies.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect the crash via failed mem.* calls.
2. Check mem.process.list; if gone, the game died.
3. Relaunch with androidopenapp; re-derive addresses (ASLR!).
4. Never write using stale addresses.

skills.name: Server-sync caution
skills.description: Know when memory edits will not stick.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer offline or single-player targets for modifications.
2. Watch for value snapping back after edits (server authority).
3. Do not repeatedly fight server-side validation.
4. Be explicit with the user about online risks.

skills.name: Multi-process target selection
skills.description: Pick the right process in multi-process apps.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.process.list shows multiple entries for some apps.
2. The main process usually has the largest memory footprint.
3. Verify by scanning a known value in each candidate.
4. Record the correct pid; avoid cross-process writes.

skills.name: Large-region scan performance
skills.description: Scan efficiently on big games.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Restrict scans to heap and anonymous RW regions (mem.regions).
2. Scan in chunks; cancel unproductive regions early.
3. Prefer refinement over ever-wider first scans.
4. Report scan statistics with results.

skills.name: Value snapshots for rollback
skills.description: Snapshot memory state before experiments.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.read full values at target addresses.
2. Store them in a workspace reference file (file.write).
3. Proceed with experiments.
4. Restore originals via mem.write when the user asks to revert.

skills.name: Multiple instance handling
skills.description: Handle games with many similar values.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. After refinement, test each candidate independently.
2. The value that changes gameplay is the target.
3. Note pointer paths for the true instance.
4. Leave non-targets untouched.

skills.name: Native patch verification
skills.description: Verify binary patches took effect.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.write the patched bytes at the computed address.
2. mem.read back; byte-compare.
3. Trigger the code path in-game.
4. Observe behavior; check logcat for integrity-check crashes.

skills.name: Memory session documentation
skills.description: Record findings for future sessions.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note target version, module base and key addresses.
2. Store with file.write in the workspace.
3. memory.save durable facts (tool availability, game quirks) — never secrets.
4. Reference notes at the next session start.

skills.name: Ethical use boundaries
skills.description: Keep memory work within legal, ethical use.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the user owns the target or has permission.
2. Refuse cheating in competitive online play.
3. Prefer offline/educational targets.
4. State the boundary plainly when a request crosses it.
